initiatives.name: Board Departures and Transitions
initiatives.summary: Catherine Faiers, Chief Operating Officer, stepped down from the Board on 9 December 2025 to become Chief Executive Officer at Moonpig plc. Her departure is noted alongside reduced share-based payment costs reflecting lapsed awards.

evidence.title: Chief Operating Officer Departs for External CEO Role
evidence.summary: Catherine Faiers, Chief Operating Officer, stepped down from the Board on 9 December 2025 to become Chief Executive Officer at Moonpig plc. Her departure is noted alongside reduced share-based payment costs reflecting lapsed awards.
evidence.quote: We would also like to acknowledge Catherine Faiers, our Chief Operating Officer, who stepped down from the Board on 9 December 2025. Catherine has taken up the role of Chief Executive Officer at Moonpig plc, an opportunity that is well deserved.

evidence.title: Two Non-Executive Directors Depart After Term Completion
evidence.summary: Jeni Mundy and Sigga Sigurdardottir did not stand for re-election at the September 2025 AGM, as part of planned Board succession in line with the Corporate Governance Code's nine-year independence guideline. This represents a significant refresh of Board composition following the company's 2015 IPO.
evidence.quote: Accordingly, at the AGM on 18 September 2025, Jeni Mundy and Sigga Sigurdardottir did not stand for re-election. We thank them for their significant contributions, including Jeni's leadership as a Committee Chair.

evidence.title: Non-Executive Directors Step Down at AGM 2025
evidence.summary: Jeni Mundy and Sigga Sigurdardottir stepped down from the Board at the 2025 AGM after completing their terms of service, prompting the search for replacement directors with enhanced technology and digital marketplace expertise.
evidence.quote: Jeni Mundy, Chair of the Corporate Responsibility Committee who reached the end of her third three‑year term in 2025, did not stand for re‑election at the 2025 AGM. Sigga Sigurdardottir also stepped down at the AGM, having completed her second three‑year term.

initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programmes
initiatives.summary: The company plans to accelerate share buybacks in financial year 2027, targeting approximately £500 million in share purchases, continuing a trend from £369.1 million spent in FY2026 and £187.3 million in FY2025.

evidence.title: Accelerated Share Buyback Programme for FY2027
evidence.summary: The company plans to accelerate share buybacks in financial year 2027, targeting approximately £500 million in share purchases, continuing a trend from £369.1 million spent in FY2026 and £187.3 million in FY2025.
evidence.quote: For financial year 2027, we expect to continue the recent acceleration of share buybacks, purchasing c.£500m of shares and continuing with our existing dividend policy.

evidence.title: Significant Share Buyback Programme
evidence.summary: Autotrader executed a substantial share buyback programme, purchasing 6.65% of its own ordinary shares for a total consideration of £369.1 million, reflecting capital return strategy rather than a strategic transformation initiative, but indicating major capital allocation decisions.
evidence.quote: In the year ended 31 March 2026, a total of 58,493,141 ordinary shares of £0.01 were purchased, representing 6.65% of its own ordinary shares (excluding shares held in treasury) as at 31 March 2025. The average price paid was 630.1p with a total consideration paid of £369.1m, (including broker fees of £552.8k) and stamp duty fees of £1.9m.

initiatives.name: Board Composition Refresh (New Directors)
initiatives.summary: Megan Quinn and Adam Jay were appointed to the Board effective 1 July 2025 to strengthen technology and digital marketplace expertise, following a formal search process led by the Nomination Committee. This followed the scheduled departure of several Non-Executive Directors completing their three-year terms.

evidence.title: Megan Quinn Succeeds as Corporate Responsibility Committee Chair
evidence.summary: Following Jeni Mundy's departure, Megan Quinn was appointed as the new Chair of the Corporate Responsibility Committee, effective from the conclusion of the 2025 AGM, ensuring continuity of ESG oversight.
evidence.quote: Megan Quinn also succeeded Jeni as Chair of the Corporate Responsibility Committee with effect from the conclusion of the 2025 AGM.

evidence.title: Two New Non-Executive Directors Appointed to Board
evidence.summary: Megan Quinn and Adam Jay were appointed to the Board effective 1 July 2025 to strengthen technology and digital marketplace expertise, following a formal search process led by the Nomination Committee. This followed the scheduled departure of several Non-Executive Directors completing their three-year terms.
evidence.quote: Megan Quinn and Adam Jay were appointed to the Board with effect from 1 July 2025, strengthening the Board's technology and digital marketplace experience.

evidence.title: Two New Non-Executive Directors Appointed
evidence.summary: Autotrader appointed Megan Quinn and Adam Jay as new Independent Non-Executive Directors, selected specifically to strengthen technology expertise and digital marketplace experience on the Board following departures of previous directors. Both joined the Board and multiple committees effective 1 July 2025.
evidence.quote: These priorities informed the selection of the new Non‑Executive Directors appointed on 1 July 2025, Megan Quinn and Adam Jay.

initiatives.name: Manchester Head Office Relocation
initiatives.summary: Autotrader completed its relocation to a new head office campus at Circle Square in Manchester, providing a modern working environment, increased collaboration space, and stronger environmental credentials (targeting BREEAM Excellent, NABERS 5-star, EPC A ratings). The move drove increased depreciation and amortisation costs and contributed to higher Scope 3 emissions from one-off capital costs.

evidence.title: New Manchester Head Office at Circle Square
evidence.summary: Autotrader completed its relocation to a new head office campus at Circle Square in Manchester, providing a modern working environment, increased collaboration space, and stronger environmental credentials (targeting BREEAM Excellent, NABERS 5-star, EPC A ratings). The move drove increased depreciation and amortisation costs and contributed to higher Scope 3 emissions from one-off capital costs.
evidence.quote: During the year, we completed the move to our new office at Circle Square in Manchester. Although only a short distance from our previous site, this new campus represents a meaningful step forward.

evidence.title: Company Name Change to Autotrader Group plc
evidence.summary: The Company changed its name to Autotrader Group plc during the year and relocated its registered office to a new address in Manchester, reflecting broader brand and corporate restructuring.
evidence.quote: During the year the Company changed its name to Autotrader Group plc by way of means provided for in the Company's Articles of Association. The Company also changed its registered office to No.3 Circle Square, 3 Hawkshaw Street, Manchester, M1 7BL.

initiatives.name: Proprietary AI Models Deployment at Scale
initiatives.summary: Autotrader is actively using more than 50 AI and machine learning models across its operations, combining large language models with its proprietary real-time dataset to improve buyer experience, automate retailer tasks and enhance colleague productivity. This includes a dedicated AI platform built to quickly build, train and roll out AI services.

evidence.title: Over 50 Proprietary AI Models Deployed Across Operations
evidence.summary: Autotrader is actively using more than 50 AI and machine learning models across its operations, combining large language models with its proprietary real-time dataset to improve buyer experience, automate retailer tasks and enhance colleague productivity. This includes a dedicated AI platform built to quickly build, train and roll out AI services.
evidence.quote: To support these we're actively using over 50 AI models across our operations, combining advanced Large Language Models with our own proprietary, real-time dataset.

evidence.title: Significant Increase in AI-Related R&D Activity
evidence.summary: Autotrader continues to invest in data technologies as a core part of its innovation strategy, with R&D activity related to AI increasing significantly over the past year. This reflects the company's ongoing digital transformation and technology investment priorities.
evidence.quote: We continue to invest in data technologies in particular, and the amount of R&D activity related to AI has increased significantly in the last year.

initiatives.name: Dealer Auction Joint Venture Growth
initiatives.summary: Autotrader's joint venture, Dealer Auction, saw its share of profit increase 14% to £4.1 million, driven by higher volume of vehicle transactions, contributing to overall Autotrader operating profit.

evidence.title: Dealer Auction Joint Venture Profit Growth
evidence.summary: Autotrader's joint venture, Dealer Auction, saw its share of profit increase 14% to £4.1 million, driven by higher volume of vehicle transactions, contributing to overall Autotrader operating profit.
evidence.quote: The Group's share of profit from our joint venture, Dealer Auction, increased 14% to £4.1m (2025: £3.6m), driven by a higher volume of vehicle transactions.

initiatives.name: Cloud Migration from Legacy Data Centres
initiatives.summary: Autotrader has completed a full technical migration from legacy private data centre systems to a modern cloud-based delivery and data platform built largely on open-source technologies, done within existing cost base. This includes migrating 100% of data centres to cloud providers as part of the technology platform's long-term evolution.

evidence.title: Full Cloud Migration from Legacy Private Data Centres
evidence.summary: Autotrader has completed a full technical migration from legacy private data centre systems to a modern cloud-based delivery and data platform built largely on open-source technologies, done within existing cost base. This includes migrating 100% of data centres to cloud providers as part of the technology platform's long-term evolution.
evidence.quote: We have already transitioned fully to a modern cloud-based delivery and data platform based largely on open-source technologies. We've adopted these emerging technologies always within our existing cost base.

initiatives.name: ESG Governance and Responsible Change Forum
initiatives.summary: Autotrader established a new executive-level Responsible Change Forum this year, bringing together senior stakeholders including the CEO and CFO to shape, oversee and drive ESG strategy, reporting quarterly to the Corporate Responsibility Committee with focus on environment and digital inclusion.

evidence.title: New Responsible Change Forum for ESG Governance
evidence.summary: Autotrader established a new executive-level Responsible Change Forum this year, bringing together senior stakeholders including the CEO and CFO to shape, oversee and drive ESG strategy, reporting quarterly to the Corporate Responsibility Committee with focus on environment and digital inclusion.
evidence.quote: This year, we established a new executive forum, the Responsible Change Forum. The Responsible Change Forum ensures our ESG strategy is focused, measurable and aligned to what matters most – driving meaningful progress in areas like environment and digital inclusion while maintaining strong governance and accountability.

evidence.title: Executive Responsible Change Forum Established for ESG
evidence.summary: Autotrader established a new executive-level Responsible Change Forum during the year to shape, prioritise and deliver the company's ESG agenda, strengthening accountability and integration of ESG into core business strategy beyond the Board committee's oversight role.
evidence.quote: During the year, we established our Responsible Change Forum. While the Committee retains oversight responsibility, the Forum operates as an executive forum focused on shaping, prioritising and delivering Autotrader's ESG agenda, ensuring progress against agreed priorities, robust external reporting, and effective integration into the core business strategy.

initiatives.name: Buying Signals ML Product Launch
initiatives.summary: Buying Signals is a proprietary machine learning model trained on verified, anonymised sales transactions and consumer interactions, designed to identify high-intent buyers for retailers. Launched in January 2026, it has already featured on over 800,000 enquiries with high-intent leads converting at twice the average rate.

evidence.title: Buying Signals ML Product Launched January 2026
evidence.summary: Buying Signals is a proprietary machine learning model trained on verified, anonymised sales transactions and consumer interactions, designed to identify high-intent buyers for retailers. Launched in January 2026, it has already featured on over 800,000 enquiries with high-intent leads converting at twice the average rate.
evidence.quote: In January 2026, we launched our Buying Signals product, which uses a proprietary machine learning model trained on verified but anonymised sales transactions and consumer interactions.

initiatives.name: Co-Driver AI Product for Retailers
initiatives.summary: Co-Driver is a generative AI-powered product that automates vehicle description generation, vehicle highlights, image tagging, ordering and optimisation for retailers, reducing average listing time from 28 minutes to 5 minutes. It was included in the April 2025 pricing and packaging event and has been adopted by 86% of retailers since launch.

evidence.title: Co-Driver AI Product Automates Vehicle Listings for Retailers
evidence.summary: Co-Driver is a generative AI-powered product that automates vehicle description generation, vehicle highlights, image tagging, ordering and optimisation for retailers, reducing average listing time from 28 minutes to 5 minutes. It was included in the April 2025 pricing and packaging event and has been adopted by 86% of retailers since launch.
evidence.quote: As part of our 1 April 2025 pricing and product event, we included Co-Driver which anecdotally reduces the average time taken to list a vehicle from 28 minutes to 5 minutes, which is significant when multiplied across more than 340,000 vehicles uploaded every month by retailers.

initiatives.name: Deal Builder Digital Retailing Platform
initiatives.summary: Deal Builder is a digital retailing product enabling higher quality enquiries and online transaction completion, scaled from 2,000 to 6,700 retailers and from 84,000 to 175,000 live vehicles year-over-year. Despite roll-out friction and negative retailer sentiment, the company is continuing to onboard large customers with custom integrations.

evidence.title: Deal Builder Digital Retailing Platform Scaling
evidence.summary: Deal Builder is a digital retailing product enabling higher quality enquiries and online transaction completion, scaled from 2,000 to 6,700 retailers and from 84,000 to 175,000 live vehicles year-over-year. Despite roll-out friction and negative retailer sentiment, the company is continuing to onboard large customers with custom integrations.
evidence.quote: In the year, we have continued to scale Deal Builder, with over 6.7k retailers on the product (March 2025: 2.0k) and 175k vehicles live at the end of March (March 2025: 84k).

initiatives.name: Digital Inclusion Partnership Initiative
initiatives.summary: Autotrader partnered with Good Things Foundation and Greater Manchester Combined Authority to tackle digital exclusion across Greater Manchester, contributing commercial insight to explore sustainable approaches to affordable digital access. The partnership will produce a five-year roadmap to help shape future policy.

evidence.title: Digital Inclusion Partnership with Good Things Foundation
evidence.summary: Autotrader partnered with Good Things Foundation and Greater Manchester Combined Authority to tackle digital exclusion across Greater Manchester, contributing commercial insight to explore sustainable approaches to affordable digital access. The partnership will produce a five-year roadmap to help shape future policy.
evidence.quote: Tackling digital exclusion through a new partnership with the national charity, Good Things Foundation and Greater Manchester Combined Authority ('GMCA'). The output will create a five-year roadmap to help shape future policy.

evidence.title: New Partnership with The Good Things Foundation
evidence.summary: Autotrader entered into a partnership with national charity The Good Things Foundation to support digital inclusion initiatives, expanding its efforts beyond the existing Forever Manchester partnership.
evidence.quote: this year the Group embarked on a partnership with the national charity, The Good Things Foundation.

evidence.title: Digital Inclusion Elevated as Key ESG Priority
evidence.summary: The Group elevated digital inclusion as a core ESG priority given its role as a digital marketplace, entering a new partnership with national charity The Good Things Foundation in addition to its existing Digital Inclusion fund with Forever Manchester.
evidence.quote: This year, the Group has elevated digital inclusion as one of its ESG priorities. ... In addition to the Autotrader Digital Inclusion fund (operated in partnership with Forever Manchester) being available for applications, this year the Group embarked on a partnership with the national charity, The Good Things Foundation.

initiatives.name: Debt Facility Accordion Expansion
initiatives.summary: The Group accessed its £100.0m accordion option subsequent to year end, increasing its existing debt facility to £300.0m, with all lenders committed to a maturity date of February 2030. This provides additional financial flexibility for the Group, categorized here as a capital structure/financing event.

evidence.title: Increased Debt Facility via £100m Accordion
evidence.summary: The Group accessed its £100.0m accordion option subsequent to year end, increasing its existing debt facility to £300.0m, with all lenders committed to a maturity date of February 2030. This provides additional financial flexibility for the Group, categorized here as a capital structure/financing event.
evidence.quote: On 15 May 2026, the Group accessed its £100.0m accordion, increasing its existing debt facility to £300.0m. Debt fees of £0.7m were incurred and will be amortised over the facility term. All lenders are now committed to the maturity date of February 2030 and there are no changes to the terms of the Syndicated RCF.

initiatives.name: Academic AI Research Partnerships
initiatives.summary: Autotrader has maintained ongoing research partnerships with Manchester Metropolitan University and the University of Manchester since 2019, focused on Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models, producing academic whitepapers that inform internal AI development.

evidence.title: Academic AI Research Partnerships with Manchester Universities

initiatives.name: Net Zero and Carbon Reduction Targets
initiatives.summary: Autotrader is committed to being net zero by 2040 and halving carbon emissions by 2030, with targets validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Emissions rose 55% to c.144.1k tonnes CO2 this year, driven by office relocation capex and vehicle purchases in the Autorama leasing business.

evidence.title: Net Zero by 2040 and 2030 Carbon Reduction Targets

evidence.quote: We are committed to being net zero by 2040 and halving our carbon emissions by 2030, targets which have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative ('SBTi').

initiatives.name: Apprenticeship and Talent Development Programmes
initiatives.summary: Average FTE headcount declined 2% to 1,244 as the company stabilizes resourcing levels, while simultaneously expanding early careers programmes including the first T-Level placements and an expanded Level 4 Software Engineering Apprenticeship.

evidence.title: Stabilized Headcount Amid Expanded Apprenticeship Programmes
evidence.summary: Average FTE headcount declined 2% to 1,244 as the company stabilizes resourcing levels, while simultaneously expanding early careers programmes including the first T-Level placements and an expanded Level 4 Software Engineering Apprenticeship.
evidence.quote: The average number of FTEs declined 2% to 1,244, as we stabilise resourcing levels currently required to support the business.

initiatives.name: FCA Motor Finance Commission Redress Scheme
initiatives.summary: The FCA confirmed on 30 March 2026 a consumer redress scheme for historic motor finance commissions, though its launch has been paused pending legal challenges referred to the Upper Tribunal. Autotrader states it believes it has no direct liability but continues to monitor developments and impact on the automotive finance market.

evidence.title: FCA Motor Finance Commission Redress Scheme
evidence.summary: The FCA confirmed on 30 March 2026 a consumer redress scheme for historic motor finance commissions, though its launch has been paused pending legal challenges referred to the Upper Tribunal. Autotrader states it believes it has no direct liability but continues to monitor developments and impact on the automotive finance market.
evidence.quote: On 30 March 2026, the FCA set out confirmation of a consumer redress scheme for certain commissions earned on historic motor finance agreements. On 1 May, the FCA confirmed that the scheme had been subject to legal challenges from several lenders.

initiatives.name: CMA Investigation into Online Reviews
initiatives.summary: On 27 March 2026 the Competition and Markets Authority announced an investigation into several companies regarding online consumer reviews, including Autotrader and its third-party moderator Feefo. The company states it has no additional information on specific concerns but will cooperate fully.

evidence.title: CMA Investigation into Online Consumer Reviews
evidence.summary: On 27 March 2026 the Competition and Markets Authority announced an investigation into several companies regarding online consumer reviews, including Autotrader and its third-party moderator Feefo. The company states it has no additional information on specific concerns but will cooperate fully.
evidence.quote: On 27 March 2026 the Competition and Markets Authority ('CMA'), exercising its new direct consumer enforcement powers, announced an investigation into a number of companies in relation to online consumer reviews, including Autotrader and our third-party moderator, Feefo.

initiatives.name: Organisational Restructuring
initiatives.summary: The company underwent organisational restructuring during the year, contributing to a significant decline in employee engagement (72% vs 91% prior year). Restructured teams were implemented in parts of the business alongside a tighter office attendance policy.

evidence.title: Organisational Restructuring Impacts Employee Morale
evidence.summary: The company underwent organisational restructuring during the year, contributing to a significant decline in employee engagement (72% vs 91% prior year). Restructured teams were implemented in parts of the business alongside a tighter office attendance policy.
evidence.quote: The last year has involved lots of change and it has been a challenging time for our employees. However, the foundations have been laid for continued success in the future, including a state-of-the-art office, refreshed hybrid-working model and restructured teams in parts of our business.

initiatives.name: New Car and Personal Leasing Market Expansion
initiatives.summary: Autotrader is integrating leasing offers into its core search experience and building a more scalable checkout journey, aiming to grow profitably as volume returns to the personal leasing channel, with new car listings increasing and EVs making up 24% of new car stock.

evidence.title: Expansion into New Car and Leasing Market
evidence.summary: Autotrader is integrating leasing offers into its core search experience and building a more scalable checkout journey, aiming to grow profitably as volume returns to the personal leasing channel, with new car listings increasing and EVs making up 24% of new car stock.
evidence.quote: We continued to focus on integrating leasing offers into the core Autotrader search experience. The goal is to enable a more scalable and robust checkout journey on all platforms and to ensure we are set up to grow profitably as volume returns to the personal leasing channel ('PCH').
